instances.Council: The full Council: the Mayor and the ten Councillors, deciding for the whole city.
instances.Regular Council: A regular meeting of the full Council.
instances.Special Council: A Council meeting called outside the regular schedule, usually for one matter.
instances.Public Hearing: Council sitting to hear the public before deciding on rezoning and development applications.
instances.Policy & Strategic Priorities: A standing committee of the whole Council on policy and strategic matters; its decisions are referred to Council.
instances.City Finance & Services: A standing committee of the whole Council on finance, contracts and services; its decisions are referred to Council.
instances.Courts of Revision: Council sitting to hear appeals on local improvement charges and parcel taxes.
instances.Auditor General Committee: The Council committee that oversees the City’s Auditor General.
